import unreal
# Inspect the RenderTarget2D DI input's binding options. The module OccupancyRT is a DI that
# itself has a 'render_target_user_parameter' binding OR can own an internal RT.
# Check what types the Niagara user-parameter add flow exposes for RenderTarget2D DI.
di=unreal.NiagaraDataInterfaceRenderTarget2D
cdo=unreal.get_default_object(di)
# The DI binds to a user param of type... print its RenderTargetUserParameter struct
rtup=cdo.get_editor_property('render_target_user_parameter')
print('render_target_user_parameter:', rtup)
# Also: is there an 'OverrideRenderTargetFormat'/size to make DI self-own an RT? For preview.
for p in ['size','override_render_target_format']:
    try: print(p, cdo.get_editor_property(p))
    except Exception as e: print(p,'err',str(e)[:60])
